title: Hello Circle
description: Draw circle-frame shapes two ways (by diameter, by radius) and change the shape inside the frame.

bubble.title: Circle Keys
bubble.body: The Circle Keys draw circle-frame shapes the same way Rect Keys draw rectangles: steer to a point, press a key, steer to a second point, press again. Two keys size the circle two ways.

bubble.title: Watch: circle by diameter
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program presses M at one end of a diameter, then at the other end, and the circle lands between them.

demo.title: One end of the diameter
demo.body: Steering to the first end. M starts Circle by Diameter.

demo.title: The other end
demo.body: Steering across. The circle will span exactly these two points.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: The second M press deposits the circle, its diameter between the two presses.

bubble.title: Your turn: press M
bubble.body: Steer to one end of the diameter you want, then press M to start Circle by Diameter.

bubble.title: Place the other end
bubble.body: Steer to the opposite end of the diameter and press M again to deposit your circle.

bubble.title: Watch: circle by radius
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program presses N at the centre, then at a point on the rim — centre first, radius second.

demo.title: The centre
demo.body: Steering to the centre. N starts Circle by Radius.

demo.title: A point on the rim
demo.body: Steering out to the rim. The distance from the centre sets the radius.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: The second N press deposits the circle around the centre you picked.

bubble.title: Your turn: press N
bubble.body: Steer to where the centre should be, then press N to start Circle by Radius.

bubble.title: Place a point on the rim
bubble.body: Steer out to the rim and press N again to deposit your circle.

bubble.title: Change the shape inside
bubble.body: This selector in the Circle Keys section chooses the shape the circle frame draws. Open it and choose Polygon — the next circle you draw will put a polygon inside its frame.

bubble.title: Circles, key-clicked
bubble.body: Circles work exactly like rectangles: steer, press, steer, press. The frame is round; the shape inside it is your choice from the selector.
